title: Rectangle footprint
expected: Extrude every footprint segment; preserve the rectangle footprint outline rather than replacing it with its bounding rectangle.
limitations: v1.7 supplies footprint points but does not map each wall face to a specific point pair; repeated cardinal elevations are the only available hint.

title: L-shaped footprint
expected: Extrude every footprint segment; preserve the l-shaped footprint outline rather than replacing it with its bounding rectangle.
limitations: v1.7 supplies footprint points but does not map each wall face to a specific point pair; repeated cardinal elevations are the only available hint.

title: T-shaped footprint
expected: Extrude every footprint segment; preserve the t-shaped footprint outline rather than replacing it with its bounding rectangle.
limitations: v1.7 supplies footprint points but does not map each wall face to a specific point pair; repeated cardinal elevations are the only available hint.

title: U-shaped footprint
expected: Extrude every footprint segment; preserve the u-shaped footprint outline rather than replacing it with its bounding rectangle.
limitations: v1.7 supplies footprint points but does not map each wall face to a specific point pair; repeated cardinal elevations are the only available hint.

title: Two connected volumes of different heights
expected: Show a 6 m-high main body joined to a distinct 3 m-high secondary volume with its own flat roof.
limitations: v1.7 has no attachment story count, attachment wall-face linkage, attachment footprint polygon, or attachment eave/ridge heights; only dimensions and parent links encode this case.

title: Gable roof
expected: Two slopes meeting at one ridge; gable triangles only on left and right walls.
limitations: Face records have no boundary vertices or edge-to-face links.

title: Hip roof
expected: Four sloped facets, a shortened ridge and four hips; no vertical gable triangles.
limitations: The schema identifies hip edge lengths but not their endpoints or incident faces.

title: Half-hip roof
expected: Partial gables capped by small hip facets; visibly different from both full gable and full hip.
limitations: v1.7 calls half-hip jerkinhead and has no facet topology or explicit half-hip run.

title: Flat roof
expected: One horizontal membrane facet at parapet height, with no ridge or gable.
limitations: Parapet plan geometry and drainage slope are not represented.

title: Shed mono-pitch roof
expected: One continuous facet rising from the front eave to the higher back wall; no centered ridge.
limitations: Per-elevation height can state high/low sides but roof face boundaries are absent.

title: Cross gable roof
expected: Intersecting main and transverse gables with two valleys and two ridges.
limitations: roof_type must be other; v1.7 cannot associate roof facets, valleys and ridges into topology.

title: Gable with a lower gable wing
expected: A main gable plus a shorter attached wing with two roof facets and its own lower ridge.
limitations: The attachment has dimensions and parent roof faces, but v1.7 has no attachment ridge/eave height fields or explicit roof topology.

title: Attached garage with flat roof
expected: Attached right-side garage at its measured 6.5 x 6.5 x 3 m size, capped by its RF-3 flat roof.
limitations: Garage is represented as generic addition because v1.7 has no garage attachment type or attachment wall linkage.

title: Attached garage with its own gable roof
expected: Attached right-side garage with a separate lower gable roof RF-3/RF-4, not a copy of the main roof.
limitations: No attachment eave/ridge heights or facet topology are available.

title: Detached garage
expected: A separate 6 x 6 x 3 m garage, not touching the house.
limitations: v1.7 position_mm is parent-face-relative and provides no site coordinate system for detached objects; exact detached placement is unknowable.

title: One-story annex
expected: A 3 m-high rear annex with a distinct flat roof.
limitations: No attachment story count, wall-face ownership or roof elevation is declared by v1.7.

title: Two-story annex
expected: A 6 m-high rear annex, visibly taller than the one-story case, with a distinct flat roof.
limitations: Story count and floor levels are not fields on attachments; height is the only discriminator.

title: Entrance canopy
expected: A thin 250 mm canopy projecting 1.6 m from WL-1, not a room-sized box.
limitations: Canopy has no dedicated attachment type; type other plus dimensions is the only schema-valid representation.

title: Porch
expected: A 5 x 2.5 m one-story front porch with its own flat roof.
limitations: Porch has no dedicated type or open/closed/support geometry in v1.7.

title: Bay window
expected: A shallow 0.9 m projection from WL-1, retaining the measured 2.4 m width.
limitations: v1.7 does not describe bay side-wall angles or bay footprint.

title: Gable dormer
expected: A roof-mounted dormer with a peaked gable roof at RF-1 position.
limitations: Dormer style and face pitch exist, but dimensions do not encode dormer roof ridge/eave or cheek topology.

title: Shed dormer
expected: A wider roof-mounted dormer with one 12-degree mono-pitch roof, distinct from the gable dormer.
limitations: Dormer face_pitch_deg does not define roof direction or facet boundaries.

title: Balcony
expected: A shallow elevated platform on WL-1 at y=3.3 m, not a ground-level solid addition.
limitations: Railings, slab thickness and supports have no declared fields.

title: Awning
expected: A 180 mm-thick wall-mounted awning projecting 1.2 m, with its own RF-3 covering plane.
limitations: Slope/direction for non-dormer attachment roofs can only be inferred from the parent roof-face pitch record.

title: Flat panel on a wall
expected: A 100 mm-deep 2.4 x 1.2 m panel mounted on WL-1 at y=3.3 m; do not inflate it into a box.
limitations: Panel has no dedicated type, orientation or surface-normal field; type other and parent wall are the available representation.

title: Chimney
expected: A 0.9 x 0.7 m chimney rising 1.8 m above RF-1 at the stated roof-relative position.
limitations: Roof-relative x/y has no facet coordinate frame or surface equation in v1.7, so world placement cannot be exact.

title: Sloped site with per-side eave heights
expected: Respect four grade offsets and side-specific eave heights; wall bottoms follow grade while roof eaves remain coherent.
limitations: v1.7 provides per-elevation values but no grade polyline or per-footprint-vertex elevations, so corners with differing offsets are underdetermined.

title: Measurement without footprint outline
expected: Degrade to the declared 12 x 8 m width/depth rectangle and issue a visible approximation warning rather than crash.
limitations: The schema allows footprint.points to be absent; without it, only a rectangular width/depth fallback can be justified.

title: Attachment with missing dimensions
expected: Keep the main house valid, omit or visibly placeholder the underdetermined addition, and identify AT-1 in a warning.
limitations: Attachment dimension fields are nullable; there is no schema-defined default size and inventing one would be misleading.
